question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution: The correct answer is '**Magnificientt'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The incorrectly spelt word is **''Magnificientt'.** • The correct spelling word is "**Magnificent**," which implies being impressively beautiful, elaborate, or extravagant **(शानदार)**. • For example: The fireworks created a **magnificent **spectacle in the night sky. • The remaining options are **correctly spelt.** Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Spiteful**: Showing an intention to harm or upset someone. **(किसी को नुकसान पहुंचाने या परेशान करने का इरादा दिखाना।)** • **Rotational**: Related to or involving rotation or rotating motion.** (वृत्ताकार गति से संबंधित)** • **Debatable**: Something that is open to discussion or argument; not certain or confirmed. **(कुछ ऐसा जो चर्चा या तर्क-वितर्क के लिए खुला हो)** 41:Tafb, The correct answer is “**Miser**”.
